netsourcecasting.page.intro.text:
Spell costs no longer have to be paid with your own mana — the Source stored in a storage network pays instead.
Carry any AE2 wireless terminal bound to an ME Wireless Access Point, or join a dimension network and select it as your primary one, and spell costs are drawn from those networks first; only what they cannot cover comes out of your own mana.
At least one of the two has to be installed. With neither, this mod does nothing and casting behaves exactly like vanilla Ars Nouveau.
netsourcecasting.page.me_network.text:
Requires Applied Energistics 2 and Ars Énergistique together, with Source stored in the network.
Pair an AE2 wireless terminal in an ME Wireless Access Point, then put an ME Source Storage Component into the network; after that the network pays. Binding once is enough — you do not have to stay near the access point.
If the network holds no Source, the whole cost still falls back to your own mana.
Requires Beyond Dimensions.
Create a dimension network and select it as your primary one in the Primary Network Switcher, then feed Source into it through an Interdimensional Source Pathway; after that the network pays.
Only your primary network counts: if you belong to none, or have not selected one, your own mana still pays.
netsourcecasting.page.config.text:
payment.network_pays_full_cost (default true)
  true — when the network holds enough Source, casting consumes none of your own mana;
  false — your mana is spent as usual and the network covers only what you cannot pay.
sources.me_first (default true)
  true — spend the ME network's Source first, the dimension network only once it runs short;
  false — the other way round.
  No effect without Beyond Dimensions installed.
